            font-family: sans-serif;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        #test-report {
            background: #141218;
            border: 1px solid #4a381e;
            padding: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: monospace;
            white-space: pre-wrap;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .pass { color: #4ade80; }
        .fail { color: #f87171; }
    </style>
</head>

    <script src="js/core/constants.js"></script>
    <script src="js/core/utils.js"></script>
    <script src="js/systems/SettingsManager.js"></script>
    <script src="js/systems/AudioManager.js"></script>
    <script src="js/models/PlayerProgression.js"></script>
    <script src="js/models/SkillTree.js"></script>
    <script src="js/models/Character.js"></script>
    <script src="js/models/Item.js"></script>
    <script src="js/models/GatheringNode.js"></script>
    <script src="js/models/LootTable.js"></script>
    <script src="js/systems/StateManager.js"></script>
    <script src="js/systems/SkillTreeManager.js"></script>
    <script src="js/systems/AttributeManager.js"></script>
    <script src="js/systems/CombatController.js"></script>
    <script src="js/render/AssetLoader.js"></script>
    <script src="js/render/PaperdollSystem.js"></script>
    <script src="js/render/EnemyVisualRenderer.js"></script>
    <script src="js/render/EntityRenderer.js"></script>
    <script src="js/systems/DungeonEngine.js"></script>
    <script src="js/ui/SettingsUI.js"></script>

    <script>
        const report = [];
        function assert(condition, message) {
            if (condition) {
                report.push(`[PASS] ${message}`);
            } else {
                report.push(`[FAIL] ${message}`);
                console.error('Assertion failed:', message);
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
            try {
                // TEST 1: SettingsManager Initialization & Defaults
                SettingsManager.init();
                assert(!!SettingsManager.settings, 'SettingsManager foi instanciado e populado');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('audio.masterVolume') === 0.8, 'Volume Mestre padr├úo ├® 0.8 (80%)');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('audio.sfxVolume') === 0.9, 'Volume SFX padr├úo ├® 0.9 (90%)');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('visual.screenShakeIntensity') === 1.0, 'Tremor de tela padr├úo ├® 1.0 (100%)');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('visual.hitFlashEnabled') === true, 'Flash de Impacto padr├úo ├® Ligado');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('visual.emberDensity') === 'high', 'Densidade de Cinzas padr├úo ├® Alta');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('gameplay.showDamageNumbers') === true, 'N├║meros de Dano padr├úo ├® Ligado');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('gameplay.enemyHealthBars') === 'combat', 'Barras de Vida padr├úo ├® "combat"');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('controls.moveUp') === 'KeyW', 'Mapeamento padr├úo de mover cima ├® KeyW');

                // TEST 2: SettingsUI Modal Rendering & DOM
                SettingsUI.init();
                const modalEl = document.getElementById('settings-modal-overlay');
                assert(!!modalEl, 'Modal #settings-modal-overlay foi injetado no DOM');

                SettingsUI.open('audio');
                assert(modalEl.classList.contains('active'), 'Modal abriu e recebeu classe .active');
                assert(SettingsUI.isOpen === true, 'SettingsUI.isOpen ├® true');

                // TEST 3: 4 Heraldic Tabs Switching
                SettingsUI.switchTab('visual');
                assert(modalEl.querySelector('.settings-pane[data-pane="visual"]').classList.contains('active'), 'Aba Visual est├í ativa');
                SettingsUI.switchTab('gameplay');
                assert(modalEl.querySelector('.settings-pane[data-pane="gameplay"]').classList.contains('active'), 'Aba Jogabilidade est├í ativa');
                SettingsUI.switchTab('controls');
                assert(modalEl.querySelector('.settings-pane[data-pane="controls"]').classList.contains('active'), 'Aba Controles est├í ativa');
                SettingsUI.switchTab('audio');
                assert(modalEl.querySelector('.settings-pane[data-pane="audio"]').classList.contains('active'), 'Aba ├üudio est├í ativa');

                // TEST 4: Live Sliders and Toggles
                const masterSlider = modalEl.querySelector('#audio-master');
                masterSlider.value = 0.5;
                masterSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
                assert(SettingsUI.workingSettings.audio.masterVolume === 0.5, 'Slider de Volume Mestre atualizou valor de trabalho para 50%');

                const muteToggle = modalEl.querySelector('#toggle-mute-blur');
                const prevMute = SettingsUI.workingSettings.audio.muteOnBlur;
                muteToggle.click();
                assert(SettingsUI.workingSettings.audio.muteOnBlur === !prevMute, 'Interruptor Mutar em Segundo Plano alternou estado');

                // TEST 5: Key Remapping and Conflict Auto-Swap
                SettingsUI.switchTab('controls');
                // Simula remapear 'skill1' para 'KeyW' (que pertencia a moveUp)
                const swapInfo = SettingsManager.remapKey('skill1', 'KeyW');
                assert(swapInfo.swapped === true, 'Remapeamento detectou conflito e disparou troca de teclas');
                assert(swapInfo.conflictAction === 'moveUp', 'Conflito identificado corretamente com moveUp');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('controls.skill1') === 'KeyW', 'skill1 recebeu KeyW');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('controls.moveUp') === 'KeyQ', 'moveUp recebeu KeyQ via troca autom├ítica');

                // TEST 6: LocalStorage Persistence
                SettingsManager.save();
                const storedRaw = localStorage.getItem('ashen_bastion_settings');
                assert(!!storedRaw, 'Registro "ashen_bastion_settings" existe no localStorage');
                const stored = JSON.parse(storedRaw);
                assert(stored.controls.skill1 === 'KeyW', 'Configura├º├úo persistida com sucesso no localStorage');

                // TEST 7: Reset Defaults with Confirmation
                SettingsManager.resetDefaults();
                assert(SettingsManager.get('controls.skill1') === 'KeyQ', 'Restaurar Padr├Áes resetou skill1 para KeyQ');
                assert(SettingsManager.get('controls.moveUp') === 'KeyW', 'Restaurar Padr├Áes resetou moveUp para KeyW');

                // TEST 8: Audio Engine Multi-Channel
                assert(!!AudioManager, 'AudioManager global est├í dispon├¡vel');
                assert(typeof AudioManager.updateVolumes === 'function', 'AudioManager.updateVolumes est├í funcional');
                assert(typeof AudioManager.playClick === 'function', 'AudioManager.playClick sintetizador presente');
                assert(typeof AudioManager.playClash === 'function', 'AudioManager.playClash sintetizador presente');
                assert(typeof AudioManager.playDash === 'function', 'AudioManager.playDash sintetizador presente');

                // TEST 9: Global ESC Key
                window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' }));
                assert(modalEl.classList.contains('active') === false, 'Pressionar ESC fechou o modal de configura├º├Áes');
                window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' }));
                assert(modalEl.classList.contains('active') === true, 'Pressionar ESC novamente reabriu o modal');

                // Display report
                const reportEl = document.getElementById('test-report');
                reportEl.textContent = report.join('\n');
                console.log('--- TEST REPORT ---\n' + report.join('\n'));

                // Render visual representation to base64 for screenshot
                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = 1000;
                canvas.height = 700;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.fillStyle = '#0c0b0e';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

                // Draw gothic frame border
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a4625';
                ctx.lineWidth = 4;
                ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, canvas.width - 20, canvas.height - 20);

                ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
                ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Cinzel", serif';
                ctx.fillText('ÔÜÖ AUDITORIA: SISTEMA CENTRAL DE CONFIGURA├ç├òES DO BASTI├âO', 30, 45);

                ctx.fillStyle = '#9c9285';
                ctx.font = '14px monospace';
                report.forEach((line, idx) => {
                    ctx.fillStyle = line.startsWith('[PASS]') ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171';
                    ctx.fillText(line, 30, 80 + idx * 24);
                });

                document.getElementById('base64').textContent = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');

            } catch (err) {
                report.push(`[CRITICAL ERROR] ${err.message}\n${err.stack}`);
                document.getElementById('test-report').textContent = report.join('\n');
                console.error(err);
            }
        });
    </script>
